n.name: "Brinewake"
n.description: "A stormy island chain."

n.name: "Vesper"
n.description: "Brinewake\'s main port city, built around a tidal lighthouse."

n.name: "Tidal lighthouse of Vesper"
n.description: "A tidal lighthouse around which Vesper is built. Its lenses run on blue salt."

n.name: "Lantern Guild"
n.description: "The guild that maintains Vesper\'s tidal lighthouse and buys blue salt from Orin\'s miners; it does not own the mines. When the strait freezes in winter, the guild uses stored blue salt."

n.name: "Orin"
n.description: "An island where blue salt is mined."

n.name: "Blue salt"
n.description: "A salt mined on the island of Orin that powers the lenses of Vesper\'s tidal lighthouse."

n.name: "Orin\'s miners"
n.description: "Miners on Orin who mine blue salt; the Lantern Guild buys salt from them. They formed the Deep Bell Union."

n.name: "Asha Pell"
n.description: "Born on Orin, Asha Pell moved to Vesper at age six and grew up there. She captains the courier ship Nightjar and belongs to the Lantern Guild; her crew usually calls her Captain Ash. She keeps a small brass key sewn inside her left coat cuff; only her navigator, Iven Marr, knows she has it."

n.name: "Nightjar"
n.description: "A courier ship captained by Asha Pell. Its former route carrying blue salt from Orin to Vesper between April and September is retired. It now carries letters from Vesper to Kest, a southern island."

n.name: "Bren Vale"
n.description: "Captain of the fishing boat Petrel. People on the dock call him Captain. He is unrelated to Asha Pell and is not a member of the Lantern Guild; he refuses to join because he distrusts Tal Ren\'s friends."

n.name: "Petrel"
n.description: "A fishing boat captained by Bren Vale."

n.name: "Iven Marr"
n.description: "Asha Pell\'s navigator on the Nightjar; the only person who knows she has the small brass key sewn inside her left coat cuff. He lost his right eye in the winter storm of 312. He navigates using tide charts, not magic."

n.name: "Old lens room beneath Vesper\'s lighthouse"
n.description: "An old lens room beneath Vesper\'s tidal lighthouse, opened by Asha Pell\'s small brass key. A rockfall permanently sealed it in 318. Nobody has reopened it, and it has no other entrance."

n.name: "Asha\'s small brass key"
n.description: "A small brass key sewn inside Asha Pell\'s left coat cuff; it opens the old lens room beneath Vesper\'s lighthouse."

n.name: "Deep Bell Union"
n.description: "A union formed by Orin\'s miners."

n.name: "Sera Dain"
n.description: "Leader of the Deep Bell Union. She refuses to sell salt to the military but continues to honor civilian contracts with the Lantern Guild."

n.name: "Tal Ren"
n.description: "Governor of Vesper."

n.name: "Toll on blue salt shipments"
n.description: "A toll on blue salt shipments imposed in 319 by Vesper\'s governor, Tal Ren. The Lantern Guild opposes it. Bren Vale supports it because the revenue repairs fishing piers."

n.name: "Nessa"
n.description: "The Petrel\'s cook and Bren Vale\'s older sister. She is not his employee on a formal wage."

n.name: "Button"
n.description: "A black cat kept by Nessa aboard the Petrel."

n.name: "Kest"
n.description: "A southern island."
